title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
Cyber Security Analyst – LumoraX Security Operations

About Lumora Security

Lumora Security is a managed cybersecurity provider headquartered at Dubai Silicon Oasis, UAE. Our mission is to protect businesses from cyber attacks through a proactive approach: Detect, Deter and Defend. We are building LumoraX, a security platform that gives small and mid-sized businesses everything they need to stay protected, and gives the MSPs who serve them everything they need to manage, prove and bill that protection.

About the Role

As a Cyber Security Analyst, you will run security operations for LumoraX customers. You will monitor and respond across the essential security areas, protect people, devices, applications, data and the growing use of AI tools and agents, and show customers clearly what has been done to keep them safe.

Key Responsibilities

• Monitor, triage and investigate alerts across endpoint, email, identity, domain, vulnerability, backup and network security areas

• Respond to incidents, including ransomware, phishing and credential-based attacks, and complete root cause analysis

• Run vulnerability and patch management cycles and confirm remediation

• Strengthen identity and cloud security on Microsoft Azure and Entra ID, including MFA and Zero Trust principles

• Hunt threats proactively using the MITRE ATT&CK framework

• Support AI security visibility: which AI tools staff use, which agents touch company data, and who owns them

• Maintain accurate case records so every action and SLA is visible to the customer

• Prepare plain-language posture reports and quarterly reviews aligned to NIST and CIS frameworks

Qualifications and Experience

• Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Security Analyst, SOC Analyst or in a comparable security role

• Hands-on experience with a SIEM (such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk or QRadar) and an EDR (such as Sophos, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike or SentinelOne)

• Hands-on experience with a cyber security tools (such as Go Phish , Medusa , BurpSuite , AWS Guard Duty , Azure Security center , TCP Dump , Nessus , Qualys, Pfsense, Zscaler , netscope..etc)

• Sound understanding of networking, firewalls, IDS/IPS, and Windows and Linux environments

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field

• Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain risk to non-technical customers

Preferred

• Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISM, SC-200 or AZ-500

• Scripting experience in Python, PowerShell or Bash

• Familiarity with email security, DMARC, backup and vulnerability management tools

What We Offer

• Work on live customer environments within a platform-led security model

• Hands-on exposure to the full essential security stack, from endpoint to AI security

• Clear progression into senior SOC, engineering and customer-facing security roles

• Hybrid working arrangement

Location: Kerala, India. Candidates based in Kerala, or able to work from Kerala, are encouraged to apply.

Lumora Security is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Cyber Security Manager
description:
Role Overview:

HireFlex Global seeks an experienced cybersecurity leader to manage its security operations, engineering, threat management, cloud security, innovation and service delivery functions. The role combines strategic oversight with direct technical involvement. The successful candidate will lead multidisciplinary teams, strengthen security controls, manage client commitments and drive continuous service improvement. Hands-on expertise is essential. The candidate must be able to assess security events, investigate SIEM alerts, support threat hunting and guide teams through major security incidents, while maintaining accountability for people, operations and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

• Cybersecurity leadership and governance: Set the technical direction, operating priorities, performance objectives and service standards for the full cybersecurity function. Coordinate security operations, engineering, threat management, innovation and project teams. Establish effective governance, reporting and escalation processes.

• Security monitoring and incident response: Provide hands-on leadership for threat monitoring and response. Analyse SIEM events, security logs and alerts; direct triage, threat hunting, incident investigations and root cause analysis. Guide containment, remediation, escalation and post-incident improvements. Mentor analysts on complex investigations.

• Detection engineering and security platforms: Lead SIEM engineers and security platform teams. Oversee Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, endpoint security and EDR solutions. Improve log ingestion, correlation rules, detection use cases, dashboards, alert quality, system integrations and platform reliability.

• Threat management and risk reduction: Oversee threat intelligence, vulnerability assessment, threat analysis and risk prioritisation. Work with operations and engineering teams to translate risks into actionable monitoring, security controls and mitigation plans. Track critical threats and corrective actions through closure.

• Cloud security, DevSecOps and innovation: Lead Azure security and secure engineering initiatives. Advance security automation, API integrations, CI/CD security practices and cloud control improvements. Evaluate emerging tools and practical applications of data science, artificial intelligence and machine learning in cybersecurity.

• Project and service delivery: Oversee cybersecurity projects and ServiceNow service delivery. Review scope, project plans, milestones, dependencies, quality, risks and resource needs. Support on-time delivery and strong communication between technical teams, project managers and clients. Resolve complex operational and delivery issues.

• Resources, budgets and team development: Plan resource allocation, capacity, recruitment and staffing across teams. Monitor utilisation, operational costs and delivery performance. Set clear expectations, coach team members, identify skill gaps and lead technical interviews for relevant cybersecurity and engineering positions.

• Client and stakeholder engagement: Serve as a senior technical and operational contact for clients. Lead service reviews, technical discussions and critical escalations. Convert business requirements into practical delivery plans and communicate progress, risks, decisions and improvement actions clearly.

Required Expertise and Experience

• Professional background: At least 10 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, security operations or related disciplines, including leadership of multiple technical teams and complex security services.

• Security operations: Strong practical capability in Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM monitoring, log analysis, alert triage, event correlation, detection rule tuning, threat hunting, incident management and root cause analysis.

• Security technologies: Experience with Microsoft Defender, endpoint protection, EDR, security platform integration, engineering architecture and the implementation and optimisation of security controls.

• Cloud and engineering: Sound knowledge of Azure security architecture, cloud monitoring, identity protection, DevOps, DevSecOps, secure CI/CD, automation and integrations.

• Delivery and leadership: Proven ability to manage client relationships, technical escalations, project delivery, resource planning, operational governance, team development and technical recruitment.

• Additional capabilities: Familiarity with AI/ML applications in security operations is beneficial. Experience in the FMCG sector is an advantage but is not required.

Preferred Certifications

Microsoft SC-200, SC-100 or AZ-500; CISSP; CISM; or equivalent certifications in cybersecurity, cloud security or security operations.

Key Success Measures

Reliable threat monitoring and incident response; improved security platform performance and detection maturity; consistent project and service delivery; effective resource utilisation; strong team capability; and measurable improvements through automation and innovation.

title: SOC Analyst (Intermediate Position)
description:
**Company Description**
Cybex 360 LLC is a trusted cybersecurity and information security provider that helps organizations protect their digital assets against evolving threats. The company offers comprehensive solutions designed to safeguard sensitive data and support regulatory compliance. A skilled and experienced team works closely with clients to assess risks, strengthen defenses, and respond to security incidents. Cybex 360 LLC focuses on building long-term partnerships by delivering reliable, high-quality security services tailored to modern business needs.

**Role Description**
The SOC Analyst (Intermediate Position) is a full-time hybrid role based in India. The analyst will monitor security events, alerts, and logs, identify potential incidents, and escalate or respond according to established playbooks. Daily responsibilities include performing cyber threat hunting, reviewing threat intelligence, analyzing suspicious activity, and supporting incident triage and remediation. The role also involves maintaining documentation, contributing to process improvements in the Security Operations Center, and collaborating with internal teams to enhance overall cybersecurity posture. The analyst is expected to stay current with emerging threats, tools, and best practices to strengthen Cybex 360 LLC’s detection and response capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* Strong experience in Security Operations Center environments and practical knowledge of cybersecurity principles and frameworks.
* Proficiency in Cyber Threat Hunting (CTH) and Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) to proactively identify and assess emerging threats.
* Solid analytical skills for investigating security alerts, interpreting log data, and drawing accurate conclusions under time constraints.
* Familiarity with SIEM platforms, endpoint protection tools, and network security technologies.
* Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CEH, or equivalent are preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid setting, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and follow structured procedures.

title: Lead Infosec
description:
**About the Role**

Support client audit and security RFP requests, identify and automate manual GRC processes, build and maintain scripts and integrations between GRC platforms and other systems, and collaborate with teams to improve security and compliance automation while staying current on GRC automation tools and practices.

**Responsibilities**

* Support client audit and security RFP requests.
* Identify manual, repetitive GRC processes (security RFP response, evidence collection, control testing, risk scoring, reporting) and design automated workflows to replace them.
* Build and maintain scripts, workflows, and integrations that connect GRC platforms (e.g., Onspring, Archer, ServiceNow) with other security and IT systems.
* Automate evidence gathering and continuous control monitoring to support audits and reduce time spent on manual data pulls.
* Partner with GRC analysts and process owners to translate manual assessment and compliance processes into automated, repeatable workflows.
* Collaborate with other customer teams to identify opportunities for process improvement and automation across the security and compliance function.
* Stay current on GRC automation tools, low-code/no-code platforms, and scripting practices to continuously improve team efficiency.

title: Senior Manager – Sales (US Healthcare Cybersecurity Sales)
description:
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Senior Manager – Sales to drive business growth in the US healthcare and HealthTech cybersecurity market. The ideal candidate will have 10+ years of experience in B2B cybersecurity or technology services sales, with a proven track record of selling cybersecurity and compliance services to US clients.
  
  
The role involves identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with senior decision-makers, managing the complete sales cycle, and achieving revenue targets. The candidate should have experience selling at least two of the following services: HITRUST, SOC 2, HIPAA, and Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Develop and execute sales strategies for the US healthcare cybersecurity market.
  
  
Generate new business opportunities and acquire healthcare and HealthTech clients.
  
  
Build and maintain relationships with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, compliance heads, and other senior stakeholders.
  
  
Manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and client discussions to proposals, negotiations, and deal closure.
  
  
Collaborate with technical teams to develop client solutions and proposals.
  
  
Build strategic partnerships, grow existing accounts, and identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
  
  
Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and achieve quarterly and annual sales targets.
  
  
**Requirements**
10+ years of experience in B2B cybersecurity or technology services sales.
  
  
Proven experience selling to the US market, preferably in healthcare or HealthTech.
  
  
Experience selling at least two of the following: HITRUST, SOC 2, HIPAA, and VAPT.
  
  
Strong enterprise sales, negotiation, and business development skills.
  
  
Demonstrated success in meeting sales targets and closing enterprise deals.
  
  
Established relationships with US healthcare organizations or HealthTech companies are highly preferred.
  
  
Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
  
  
If you have a strong background in cybersecurity sales and are passionate about driving business growth in the US healthcare market, we encourage you to apply.
